subtotal(items) in pricing.mjs must sum integer priceCents * integer quantity, return 0 for empty input and throw RangeError for negative or non-integer prices/quantities. Zero values are valid. money(cents) in format.mjs must produce dollar strings with exactly two digits, no thousands separator, and a leading minus before the dollar sign for negatives (e.g. -105 => -$1.05). invoice(items) in invoice.mjs must compose imports of those two public functions and return "Total: " plus the formatted subtotal, propagating errors.
Arrange independent pricing and formatting work so it can run in parallel, followed by integration that consumes both results. Record their cross-module public contracts. The environment is prepared with npm ci before execution. Use npm run test:pricing, npm run test:format, npm run test:integration for the respective work, and include npm test on the integration task for the final full gate. Do not edit tests, package files, configuration or add dependencies. Only pricing.mjs, format.mjs, invoice.mjs may change. Execution agents should use file tools only; Tokage runs shell acceptance independently. Preserve public exports and use the required TaskReport format after execution. No model fallback.

# Spec
## Goals
Implement integer-cent subtotal calculation, dollar formatting, and invoice composition across the three existing modules. Pricing and formatting are independent work items; integration depends on both.

## Scope
- In scope: `pricing.mjs`, `format.mjs`, and `invoice.mjs`.
- Out of scope: tests, package files, configuration, dependencies, and all other files.

## Key decisions
- Keep the existing named public exports: `subtotal`, `money`, and `invoice`.
- Validate prices and quantities as non-negative integers; zero is valid.
- Format cents as dollars with exactly two decimal digits and no thousands separators; place a negative sign before `$`.

# Contracts
## C1 Pricing API
```ts
type Item = { priceCents: number; quantity: number };
function subtotal(items: Item[]): number; // integer-cent sum; 0 for empty input
// Throws RangeError if any priceCents or quantity is negative or non-integer.
```

## C2 Formatting API
```ts
function money(cents: number): string;
// Examples: money(0) === "$0.00"; money(105) === "$1.05"; money(-105) === "-$1.05"
// Exactly two fractional digits; no thousands separator.
```

## C3 Invoice API
```ts
function invoice(items: Item[]): string;
// Returns "Total: " + money(subtotal(items)); propagates errors from either function.
```

## C4 Directory conventions
- Preserve the current named exports in `pricing.mjs`, `format.mjs`, and `invoice.mjs`.
- Only these three module files may be changed.

# Tasks
```yaml
- id: P0.M1a
  domain: backend-api
  title: "Implement pricing subtotal"
  goal: "Implement subtotal(items) with non-negative integer validation, integer-cent multiplication and summation, and zero for empty input."
  depends_on: []
  contracts: [C1, C4]
  write_scope: ["pricing.mjs"]
  deliverables: ["Working named subtotal export"]
  acceptance:
    commands: ["npm run test:pricing"]
    criteria: ["Pricing acceptance command passes"]
  size: S
  difficulty: 1
- id: P0.M1b
  domain: backend-api
  title: "Implement money formatting"
  goal: "Implement money(cents) as a dollar string with two fractional digits, no grouping separators, and a leading minus before the dollar sign for negative amounts."
  depends_on: []
  contracts: [C2, C4]
  write_scope: ["format.mjs"]
  deliverables: ["Working named money export"]
  acceptance:
    commands: ["npm run test:format"]
    criteria: ["Formatting acceptance command passes"]
  size: S
  difficulty: 1
- id: P0.M2
  domain: integration
  title: "Compose invoice output"
  goal: "Import subtotal and money from their public modules and return Total: followed by the formatted subtotal, allowing errors to propagate."
  depends_on: [P0.M1a, P0.M1b]
  contracts: [C1, C2, C3, C4]
  write_scope: ["invoice.mjs"]
  deliverables: ["Working named invoice export composing subtotal and money"]
  acceptance:
    commands: ["npm run test:integration", "npm test"]
    criteria: ["Integration and full acceptance commands pass"]
  size: S
  difficulty: 1
```

# Notes
- Read-only review found each target module is currently a one-line placeholder; `package.json` defines the requested acceptance scripts.
- Execution agents must use file tools only. Tokage runs shell acceptance independently.
- Preserve the existing public exports; do not edit tests, package files, configuration, or add dependencies.
- After execution, report results using the required TaskReport format.

- In scope: `pricing.mjs`, `format.mjs`, and `invoice.mjs`.
- Out of scope: tests, package files, configuration, dependencies, and all other files.

## Key decisions
- Keep the existing named public exports: `subtotal`, `money`, and `invoice`.
- Validate prices and quantities as non-negative integers; zero is valid.
- Format cents as dollars with exactly two decimal digits and no thousands separators; place a negative sign before `$`.
